relations.text: 最大の顧客で、純売上高の約21%を占める
relations.text_en: Largest customer, about 21% of net sales in 2025

source.label: Kraft Heinz 10-K(2025-12-27)
source.quote: Our largest customer, Walmart Inc., represented approximately 21% of our net sales in 2025, 2024, and 2023.

relations.text: ラクタリス系企業との契約で、相互に知的財産のライセンスを永続的に付与している
relations.text_en: Granted licenses to an affiliate of Lactalis for intellectual property in perpetuity under their agreements

source.label: Kraft Heinz 10-K(2025-12-27)
source.quote: In our agreements with an affiliate of Groupe Lactalis (“Lactalis”), we granted the other party various licenses to use certain of our and their respective intellectual property rights in perpetuity, including perpetual licenses for the Kraft and Velveeta brands for certain cheese products.

companies.name: バークシャー・ハサウェイ

relations.text: 当社の普通株式の約27.5%を保有している
relations.text_en: Owns about 27.5% of the common stock

source.label: Kraft Heinz 10-K(2025-12-27)
source.quote: As of January 16, 2026, Berkshire Hathaway Inc. (“Berkshire Hathaway”) owns approximately 27.5% of our common stock.
